question: Which of the following is the address range assigned by IANA for SSM service in IPv4? A. 232.0.0.0/24 B. 225.0.0.0/8 C. 232.0.0.0/8 D. 239.0.0.0/8
Which of the following is the multicast distribution tree maintained by PIM-DM? A. SFT B. CBT C. RFT D. STP
Which of the following attributes must exist in the BGP update messages? (Select 3 answers) A. LOCAL_PREF B. NEXT_HOP C. ORIGIN D. AS_PATH
In OSPF protocol, Different types of networks cannot establish an adjacency with each other in the Full state. A. TRUE B. FALSE

The default-route originate command in the RIP protocol advertises a default RIP route to the peers. When using this command, which of the following attributes can be set for the default route? A. Tag B. Cost C. Interface D. Nexthop
What command must be configured to establish a BGP connection between indirectly connected EBGP peers? A. peer connect-interface B. peer valid-ttl-hops C. peer ignore D. peerebgp-max-hop
Generally, the performance of an IP-prefix-filter is greater than that of an ACL. A. TRUE B. FALSE

Which of the following subnet masks can be used to divide a Class C network into 5 subnets, with each subnet containing a maximum of 20 hosts? A. 255.255.255.192 B. 255.255.255.240 C. 255.255.255.224 D. 255.255.255.248
Which of the following network link type is not the basic network link type defined in OSPF? A. P2P B. P2MP C. Broadcast D. Virtual link

Which of the following statements about a neighbor state machine is true? A. The Attempt state appears only on an NBMA network or a broadcast network. B. The Attempt state appears only on an NBMA network or a P2MP network. C. LSR packets can be sent in the Exchange state. D. The Full state indicates that LSDB synchronization is complete. No LSDB information will be exchanged.
ACL rules are matched based on the configured order only. A. TRUE B. FALSE
The ABR of an NSSA does not advertise Type-4 and Type-5 LSAs to an NSSA instead it imports external routes into the NSSA, A. TRUE B. FALSE
An IP address 192.168.13.175 with the subnet mask 255.255.255.240 can be assigned to a device. A. TRUE B. FALSE

Which of the following statements regarding stub areas is false? A. An AS-external-LSA cannot be advertised into a stub area. B. The ABR in the stub area generates a default route to enable packet forwarding destined for other areas. C. Transit area cannot be a stub area. D. Any area can be configured as a Stub area.
A Router ID is optional in the OSPF configuration. A. TRUE B. FALSE

Which of the following statements regarding a multicast distribution tree are true? (Select 3 answers) A. Multicast distribution trees are classified into two types: SFT and RPT. B. The PIM-SM protocol can generate both RFTs and SPTs. C. The PIM-55M protocol can generate only SFTs. D. The PIM-DM protocol can generate both RFTs and SFTs.

What is the function of well-known community attribute NO_EXPORT_SUBCONFED in BGP? A. Routes received carrying this value cannot be advertised outside of the confederation. B. Routes received carrying this value cannot be advertised to any BGP peers. C. Routes received carrying this value cannot be advertised to any EBGP peers. D. All above statements are wrong

Over a working TCP connection, what is the state of the BGP peer relationship if the peer AS number configured for a BGP router is inconsistent with the AS number of its BGP peer? A. Idle B. Active C. OpenSent D. Established

Which of the following statements are false? (Select 3 answers) A. ASBR-Summary-LSAs describe the route to an ASBR and are flooded within an AS. B. ASE-LSAs describe the route to an external AS and are flooded to an external AS. C. AS-external-LSAs do not belong to any particular OSPF area, D. The Type-1 external metrics include only the AS external metric.

Which of the following statements is false? A. An ABR maintains a separate LSDB for each area it is attached to. ABRs have multiple LSBDs. B. Metric, an ASE LSA parameter, can be specified when an external route is imported with 1 as its default value. C. The externally-derived routing information carries a tag for transmitting additional information of the route which is commonly used in a routing policy. The default value of the Tag label is 0. D. The Link State ID is the Router ID of the ASBR for type 4 LSAs.
